artifacts.summary: Verifies the dispatch's claims about the dead /research /plan /implement command surface, catalogs exact stale regions in user-guide.md, user-installation.md, extensions/README.md, docs-README.md, and research-flow-example.md, and corrects the dispatch's framing of research-flow-example.md: it is already retargeted at /orchestrate --research but violates no-record-versioning-in-deliverables.md in four spots, which is the actual fix needed there.

memory_candidates.content: lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint/) enumerates the valid-command set by walking agent-system/extensions/*/commands/*.md (excluding README.md) and only flags a literal 'Next:'/'Run' line immediately followed by '/<name>' where <name> has no commands/<name>.md file anywhere. It does not police ordinary prose mentioning a dead command's name, only the actionable-recommendation shape. Running `bash .claude/scripts/lint/lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh --quiet` is the correct pre-commit check for any doc rewrite touching command references.

When a dispatch description asserts a file is 'built on' a removed/stale surface, verify by reading the file before assuming the fix is retarget-or-retire: docs/examples/research-flow-example.md had already been retargeted at /orchestrate --research by an earlier edit, but still carried four spans of record-versioning language ('supersedes an earlier version... were retired', a 'Document Version: 3.0' footer, etc.) that violate rules/no-record-versioning-in-deliverables.md. The real fix was stripping that language, not retargeting or retiring the file.
